Subject: Master vendor details: legal entity, billing contacts, and remit

Hi Lucia,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — excited to move Archon Supplies into our vendor roster. To finish vendor master creation and ensure POs invoice correctly, we need the following items from your side: 

- Confirm the legal entity name (as shown on tax documents) that should be used on Redwood POs and payments.
- Completed vendor onboarding form (I attached our short form link below).
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (US), and a bank letter or voided check for ACH setup.
- Primary AP contact name, email, and preferred remit instructions (ACH or wire).

You can upload documents here: https://docs.redwood.com/finance/vendor-onboarding-form or reply with attachments. If the legal name on your W-9 differs from the trade name you use on invoices, please include a short note explaining the discrepancy and any supporting docs.

Goal: get this in by EOD Monday so we can stage the first PO for your team next week.

Appreciate it — I'll loop Karthik (vendor ops) and Marissa (finance) to confirm next steps on our side.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Hi Lucia, and thanks Ben for the intro. 

Lucia — quick follow-up from vendor ops: we saw that the W-9 lists 'Archon Logistics, Inc.' while your bank image/header references 'Archon Supplies' as a DBA. That’s fine, but we need one of the following to complete the master record and set the remit name for POs/payment rails: 

1) A signed DBA declaration on company letterhead (stating Archon Logistics, Inc. DBA Archon Supplies), OR
2) A recent bank letter or ACH authorization that clearly shows the legal entity name 'Archon Logistics, Inc.' 

If you can upload the signed DBA declaration, we can set the legal entity in our ledger to 'Archon Logistics, Inc.' and configure the PO/display name to 'Archon Supplies' for ease of matching.

Also, can you confirm the tax ID (EIN) shown on the W-9? We will run it through our vendor validation checks.

Thanks — once we have that doc, I'll push the record through and open the ACH onboarding ticket.

—Karthik
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference

Looping in finance notes so everyone has the same expectations. Once vendor ops confirms the legal name mapping, finance will: 

- Create the vendor master with legal name 'Archon Logistics, Inc.' and set the invoice/PO display name to 'Archon Supplies'.
- Require W-9 on file (received) + DBA declaration (if provided) before approving ACH onboarding.
- For initial POs we'll set payment term NET 30 and default remittance to ACH to the account shown in the bank screenshot.

Lucia — please send the DBA declaration if you have it. If you prefer wire instead of ACH for the first payment, say so and include wire instructions; otherwise we'll proceed with ACH.
